authentication: bearer token from a Lens account on an institutional subscription
cost_notes: Institutional subscription only (quote-based, no public price list). Free 'Lens Scholars' accounts do not include API access.
free_tier: no free API tier; individual 'Lens Scholars' accounts are website-only
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: https://api.lens.org/scholarly/search returned HTTP 401 with {"message":"Missing/Incorrect Authorization Header"}.

The Lens Patent API Terms of Use state: 'Lens API service is only available through an institutional subscription. Individuals are encouraged to approach their institutional librarian...' - so this is PAID_ONLY, not merely registration-gated. (Quote captured from the live page at 2026-11-09T05:39Z; a repeat request minutes later was answered 403 by the site's WAF, which is itself in the probe ledger.)
Redistribution of derived data is restricted by the API terms, which conflicts with MedRadar's need to keep evidence reusable and auditable.
Prices are quoted per institution, not published as a price list; obtaining a quote is outside this round's rules.
licence: Lens Patent/Scholarly API terms of use; redistribution of derived data restricted
research_value: Would provide patent and scholarly records in one normalised index with family and citation links, useful for linking device technology to the scientific literature. Because it is institutional-subscription-only and restricts redistribution, it is not usable here and should not be planned for without a licence review.
